content.short: Triangle is a wallet API infrastructure to harmonize and secure cross-chain wallet integrations.
content.description: Triangle is a wallet API infrastructure founded by Tasti Zakari, designed to harmonize and secure wallet integrations across major blockchain protocols. It enables DeFi and NFT payments to be carried out more smoothly across ecosystems, including Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and beyond. Its API is openly accessible for developers to call and integrate into their DApps, providing a unified interface for wallet operations. For security, Triangle relies on a novel multi-party computation approach that has been battle-tested in practice.
